title: James Dean's last drive
text: Near the junction of Highways 46 and 41, just east of Cholame, the actor James Dean was killed in a crash on September 30, 1955. He was 24, and was driving his new Porsche Spyder to a sports car race in Salinas. Coming west down the long Antelope Grade, he met a Ford turning left across his path onto Highway 41, and the two cars collided almost head-on. Dean was pronounced dead on arrival at the hospital, and his passenger, a Porsche mechanic who was thrown from the car, survived.
